programme.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet S01
programme.desc: Antarctica - a land of survivors enduring the most hostile conditions on earth. 98 per cent of the mainland is covered by ice on which virtually nothing can live. Below the sea ice, conditions have been stable for millennia.

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic “The Water Margin”, and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: 荡寇志
programme.desc: 张彻导演的武侠钜作《水浒传》的延续。七大梁山的英雄义士为保国家，奉命征讨宦官专权。展开一场轰轰烈烈之荡寇大决战。

programme.title: Gossip Street
programme.desc: All neighbours gather to gossip in flat number 8 on the second floor of the Gossip Street apartment building! Most of the residents are common people from all walks of life and there is never a lack of laughter or sarcasm in the neighbourhood. However, when a local mobster wants to change the place into a gambling den, things get serious...

programme.title: 多咀街
programme.desc: 「多咀街」是一条丁字形的热闹街道，住客大多是各行各业的小市民。他们对社会所发生的大小事情喜欢谈论，七嘴八舌，招惹是非；三言两语，道出人情冷暖，有道是：言为心声。不管是粤剧艺员、暴发户、黑社会人物或司机，他们说的话是嬉笑怒骂或冷嘲热讽也好，都足以反映出现实社会人情百态之一斑。

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: 玫瑰我爱你
programme.desc: 十八岁的玫瑰在澳门结识了富家子家聪。太平洋战争爆发，两人被迫分手。七年后，玫瑰得知家聪结婚，伤心痛哭。玫瑰婚后，丈夫去世，开了一间花店，一天，小女孩来买花，才知小女孩是自己女儿，更与家聪重遇...文艺导演秦剑的爱情悲喜剧，保持作深情，感人之水准。

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: 魂断奈何天
programme.desc: 良才见秋容貌美，心怀不轨，竟将其迷奸。秋容醒来后为良才甜言蜜意所惑，相信他禀明父母后会娶她为妻。谁知数月后，良才音讯全无，秋容更发现自已怀有身孕，于是马上去找良才。可惜那时秋容才发现良才已另娶名门闺秀为妻，更打算将秋容灭口...

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Impoverished scholar Zhang Zhen seeks refuge with a chancellor's family, only to be scorned for his poverty. A carp spirit, moved by his plight, disguises herself as the chancellor's daughter and falls for him. Confusion over the two identical daughters draws a demon-hunting priest. Zhang Zhen refuses to abandon her, moving Guanyin to grant her mortal form.

programme.title: 鱼美人
programme.desc: 贫寒书生张珍投奔相府，却遭嫌贫爱富的准岳父冷落。碧波潭鲤鱼精同情他的遭遇，化身相国千金，深夜与张珍相会，两人渐生情愫。此事引发「真假千金」闹相府的风波，更招来张天师降妖围剿。面对天兵天将，张珍誓死不离，最终感动观音，令鲤鱼精化为凡人，与张珍终成眷属。

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome "Silver Fox" and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: 玉面飞狐
programme.desc: 夏梧与司马秋同为镖局掌门义子。司马秋利欲薰心，设计弑杀师父，更以暗镖毁去夏梧面容。重伤的夏梧怀抱年幼长女逃走，怀孕妻子却于昏迷中遭司马秋奸污。夏梧隐居深山，将仇恨寄托长女青青，苦心培育其成为武艺高强的「玉面飞狐」，命她下山劫镖寻仇。

programme.title: The Lady Hermit
programme.desc: The Lady Hermit hides away for years to plot revenge after being defeated by the evil Black Knight. Young swordswoman Tsui Ping is determined to take down Black Knight herself and begs Lady Hermit to teach her martial arts skills. The Black Knight's days are numbered when the Lady Hermit and her protege perfect the technique to take him down.

programme.title: 钟馗娘子
programme.desc: 钟馗娘子被邪恶的黑金刚击败后，隐居多年，处心积虑要复仇。女侠翠屏勇猛坚毅，为铲除黑金刚，恳求钟馗娘子收她为徒。娘子与翠屏两师徒联手对付黑金刚，也是他大限将至的时侯。

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: 洪拳与咏春
programme.desc: 清廷派人扫平少林寺，杀掉所有少林弟子。从中幸存出来的两名弟子，分别拜入咏春及洪拳师傅门下，学习拳法。最终他们挟技击败敌人，并为死去师兄弟报仇。

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: 野姑娘
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活泼且无畏的乡村少女，面对恶霸从不退缩，总是勇敢反抗。当她揭露了唐家大少爷的阴谋后，立刻引来他的狠毒报复。幸好，她心仪的男子大海及时挺身而出相救。两人能否携手对抗险恶命运，改写结局？

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Adapted from the classic Chinese novel of the same title, the story follows Monk Tang San Zang's journey to the West in search of the Buddhist Sutra. On the way, he encounters and takes as disciples, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing.

programme.title: 西游记
programme.desc: 本片根据中国经典同名名著改编。故事讲述唐僧赴西天取经，中途在五指山收服马骝精；在高家庄收服猪八戒；在流沙河收服沙悟净的种种情节。。

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: 我为你狂
programme.desc: 的士司机阿发与少女阿霞相爱已久，但发有神经错乱，霞为除心理负担，忍痛分手; 发大闹霞家并断指示真心，令霞感动而复合。然发却不务正业，令霞甚为反感;一次争执间，发狂性大发，霞流产，再次离开发...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master “Shadow Whip”, he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to “Shadow Whip”?

programme.title: 影子神鞭
programme.desc: 三十万镖银被持神鞭作武器的劫镖者劫去。因神鞭是有「影子神鞭」之称的武林大师方承天的招牌武器，所以他的嫌疑最大，也因此引来连番追捕。自此以后，方消声匿迹。十五年后，年轻女子杨寒云突然出现，更拿着与当年一样的神鞭。究竟这位女子是谁？「影子神鞭」的下落又如何？

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: 船
programme.desc: 故事描述一群年青人在爱情和情感相互交错下，组成多个错综复杂的多角恋情。

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is an assassin of the ‘Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When Ma starts to question the morality of his missions, he finds himself becoming a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 马腾是雍正的密令组织「血滴子特务团」的其中一位杀手。当马腾质疑其特务行动是否有违道义时，却旋即变成被同伴追捕的逃犯。

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: 玉女嬉春
programme.desc: 吕紫英陪同父吕天奇到台湾发展，两姐白虹、青萍留港继续歌舞生涯。白虹认识江庆良后投契相恋，江向老板引荐白虹在歌剧中当主角，老父回来见三位女儿成就，开心不已。

programme.title: 玉女嬉春
programme.desc: 吕紫英陪同父吕天奇到台湾发展，两姐白虹、青萍留港继续歌舞生涯。白虹认识江庆良后投契相恋，江向老板引荐白虹在歌剧中当主角，老父回来见三位女儿成就，开心不已。

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: 娃娃夫人
programme.desc: 三十五岁的男教师林明娶了十七岁的女学生珍珍。两人在同一学校上课，隐藏夫妻秘密。珍发觉林明常被女生包围，而林又发现珍常被男老师追求，期间笑料百出。

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called “Five Poison Web”, spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate. Xiong falls in love with Su who has a clue of where the plant is, but she accidentally hurts Kit when seeking the plant, devastating Xiong.

programme.title: 五毒天罗
programme.desc: 《五毒天罗》是武林至毒之物，不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇坛主，要找出天罗所在，独霸武林，误放消息，谓天罗已重现武林，江湖一片风声鹤唳...

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: 双喜临门
programme.desc: 朱国栋和李明珠本打算结婚，无奈双方父母为多年死对头，所以坚决反对婚事。于是二人不惜假装自杀。有见及此双方家长最终冰释前嫌，答应二人成婚。此时，唱片公司宣布会为出栋的歌曲版，最终可谓双喜临门。

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandit's son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: 佛都有火
programme.desc: 故事讲述，某寺青年僧人「疯子」，性格疯疯癫癫，行为全不符僧人规范。该寺主持玄明方丈却认为「疯子」与佛有缘，并因应其性格与气质，授以「癫罗汉拳」。「疯子」有了武功后，动辄出拳伤人，方丈只得将其逐出寺门...

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: 鬼屋丽人
programme.desc: 本片是根据《聊斋》中之《书痴》改编，故事描述玉柱被叔叔郎中元欺负，搬进常闹鬼的「孝廉府」。然后玉柱遇上了颜如玉，二人及后结成夫妇。郎中元之友史良金竟拐走如玉，将其迷奸。良金妻妾更毒害如玉，如玉化成厉鬼，将中元、良金等人杀害。玉柱因如玉已不在人世，不禁一阵辛酸。

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: 女儿国
programme.desc: 本片讲述唐僧、孙悟空、猪八戒及沙和尚一行四人往西天取经，行至西梁女儿国，国内全是女人，而传宗接代生儿育女全靠「招胎泉」，饮过这泉水便可成孕，但也只能生女。

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: 凤还巢
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦将次女雪娥许配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既愤且恼，对居易讹称长女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成亲。居易见雪雁貌丑而痴，吓得留书出走。富豪朱焕然对雪娥心仪已久，趁此良机冒充居易，依期迎亲......本片由李香君、金峰分饰男、女主角，配搭新鲜；而蒋光超与庄元庸一胖一瘦的谐趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮。

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: 大杀四方
programme.desc: 故事描述，民初北方军阀混战，民不聊生，纷纷向南逃难，三位青年王绪、金正平和鱼汉生，夹在难民群中，来到战区边沿。王因出手营救一女难民，致遭地方民团首领陈祖光的手下追捕，幸得风尘女子红菱所救......

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: 奸人鬼
programme.desc: 男孩小吉的父母离异后，希望寻找快乐的人生。一天，小吉喜遇好心鬼简人，并结成好友。好心鬼决定要帮助小吉的父母复合，令小吉得到真正的快乐。

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: After three years of wandering, legendary swordsman Li Xun Huan returns home, hoping for a peaceful life. Instead, countless fighters seek to kill him for fame. As chaos spreads, Li reunites with his estranged friend Ah Fei and joins forces with him to battle the deadly Money Clan, a rising threat determined to dominate the martial world.

programme.title: 魔剑侠情
programme.desc: 狄龙扮演的小李悄然回到爱侣故园之旁隐居，遥对窗中倩影，而不相见，直至发生危机，小李才露面相告，并且挺身赴难。有不少高手为争“武林排名”而找小李决斗，小李又要对付恶势力庞大的帮主谷峰，于是小李找寻旧友阿飞相助，但阿飞被阴险美女林仙儿所迷，简直变成废人，小李于是揭破这女人的假面目，并且设法使阿飞振作起来。

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: 女秀才
programme.desc: 闻蜚蛾自幼女扮男装从父习武，后更考得秀才功名，堪称文武全才。同窗好友杜子中与魏撰之虽与蜚蛾日夕相对，均不知其是女儿身。闻母见女儿年纪不小，不该再扮男装，劝蜚蛾选撰之或子中为夫婿。不料蜚娥与二人情谊相同，一时无法抉择，遂决定由天定夺，怎知阴差阳错，选婿之箭落于撰之手中。蜚娥后悔不已，才知自己意属子中...

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fan's fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: 铁扇公主
programme.desc: 唐僧师徒西行取经，受阻于烈火绵延的火焰山，唯有铁扇公主的芭蕉扇方能灭火。然而因红孩儿一事，牛魔王夫妇拒不相助。孙悟空遂与二人展开「三调芭蕉扇」的智勇较量。越过火焰山后，师徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹设下的长生圈套。面对诡计多端的妖精，悟空再施神通，护师脱险。

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: 丑闻
programme.desc: 在河北省某贪污成风的小县内，流浪汉甄明与贾亮因掌握一众县官的贪污和丑闻证据，得以顺水推舟假扮县长，把各官员玩弄于股掌之中，峰回路转，结局却出人意表。全片除带出人生如戏的黑色幽默，也狠狠地鞭挞为官者残民以自肥的无耻行为。

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: Young Long Jian Fei, a martial arts novice, is adopted by the Fire Spirit Demon who taught him the powerful Buddha's Palm, turning Long into a martial arts master. Long is tasked by the Fire Spirit Demon to takes revenge for his master, and this soon unleashes a storm upon the martial arts world...

programme.title: 如来神掌
programme.desc: 年轻龙剑飞武功低劣，但在一次偶然的机会下，被火魂邪神古汉魂收为义子，并获传授八式如来神掌。龙剑飞从此脱胎换骨，成为武林高手。为报师仇，古汉魂命龙剑飞下山替他找仇人报仇，江湖风暴遂再牵起...

programme.title: 如来神掌
programme.desc: 年轻龙剑飞武功低劣，但在一次偶然的机会下，被火魂邪神古汉魂收为义子，并获传授八式如来神掌。龙剑飞从此脱胎换骨，成为武林高手。为报师仇，古汉魂命龙剑飞下山替他找仇人报仇，江湖风暴遂再牵起...

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mu's lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Li's father...

programme.title: 游侠情
programme.desc: 杜孟飞奉命下山闯荡江湖，途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉儿，杜挺身相救，沐万分感激。未几，杜又救出被黑道中人围攻的少女李赛男。及后，杜无意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨，黑道首领是李之杀父仇人，而沐则是黑道首领失散的女儿...

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - “Twelve Deadly Coins” and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: 十二金钱镖
programme.desc: 乔茂押镖时，遇女贼袁玉蓉，举刀要杀之际，却被袁的美丽媚态吸引，后两人互生爱慕，更发现凭独门武器「十二金钱镖」名震天下的俞剑平，与背后操控袁的老头，有段血海深仇...

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: 仇连环
programme.desc: 仇连环在上海滩以拳头打出天下，乃好勇斗狠的典型人物。仇为了交际花沈菊芳不惜豁出性命，与著名帮会首脑之子及同伴展开连场明争暗斗，亦成为帮会争夺地盘的嫁祸目标。

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: 盘丝洞
programme.desc: 本片为邵氏「西游记」系列的第三部作品。唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中，希望食唐僧肉而得到永生。悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大闹盘丝洞拯救唐僧。

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒绝贿赂画师，于是一直被画师画丑致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君后，惊为天人，即选中她。画师被逐后，为报复而设计将昭君与匈奴可汗和亲。皇帝因拒绝婚事即引来两国争战，以致王昭君最后为了平息战乱不得不牺牲自己。

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: 英雄无泪
programme.desc: 江湖异人萧大师铸成宝剑「泪痕剑」，不料该剑显现出凶兆，将会带来武林浩劫，而他的亲生子注定要死在此剑之下。萧为了使此剑不危害江湖，将它交给一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。数十年后该弟子把它传给门徒小高，令其带剑下山望化解江湖劫数。

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: 血手印
programme.desc: 穷书生林肇德与富翁女儿订亲，但富翁因其家道中落而反对婚事。为迎娶挚爱，肇德上京考取功名，临行前会晤未婚妻，怎料却碰上婢女满身鲜血伏尸后花园。因不慎留下血手印于门上，他更被诬陷杀人。直至包公及时重审，为他洗脱冤情。

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: 少林三十六房
programme.desc: 武打明星刘家辉饰演反清组织成员，并逃难到少林寺求艺。为了报仇雪恨，他矢寺要在「天下武宗」少林学懂上乘的武学。他学成少林寺三十五房功夫后，创立少林寺第三十六房功夫。

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: 梁上君子
programme.desc: 本片为徐虾导演。 董骠, 钱小豪及蒋金饰扒手, 惟董失手被捕; 董出狱后装南洋阔客, 随钱及蒋返家, 因为想扮相古怪, 惹途人围观, 三人乘机施妙手, 更向盘问的保安队长罗莽自诩身份特殊, 使罗躬身谢罪...

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: 卖命小子
programme.desc: 武林名门世家子弟袁鹰飞为了对付虎威镖局少镖头关云，拉拢四位失意江湖高手对付他。岂料四人与关云不打不相识，反成好友。后袁鹰飞设下毒计害死关云，四人悲愤交集，遂联手为友复仇。

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: 钻石艳盗
programme.desc: 两大珠宝盗贼「夜来香」和「夜爵士」前往日本，意图偷去「维纳斯的眼泪」巨钻。二人见面后即坠入爱河，却不知道原来对方同为盗取巨钻的竞敌。最后谁会得到巨钻？二人的恋情又会否无疾而终？

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: 陆小凤之决战前后
programme.desc: 两大武林剑客叶孤城与西门吹雪将于紫禁城决斗。陆小凤忖度二人素末谋面，又无利益冲突，无须决斗，猜想当中一定事有蹊跷。于是，他决定和花满楼前往京城调查清楚，却发现当中隐藏的阴谋...

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: 貂蝉
programme.desc: 汉朝末年太师董卓霸道专横，弄权祸国，忠臣王允誓要利用貂蝉的美色设计除掉董卓。王允得知董卓的义子吕布见貂蝉貌若天仙一见钟情，于是将计就计把貂蝉献给董卓为妾，终使父子反目。吕布最后杀了父亲董卓，自此与貂蝉成为眷属。

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: 盗剑
programme.desc: 韩九重为夺削铁如泥的青霜剑，诱杀师弟谈鹤鸣；谈鹤鸣的妻子耿六娘隐姓埋名在将军府为佣，伺机夺剑报仇。将军女儿娇龙拜六娘为师，练成一身武艺，并与六娘师侄罗翼虎相恋。翼虎顺娇龙之意，深夜到亲王府盗剑，然而寡不敌众，失手被擒；娇龙率众营救，与韩九重等人展开连场激战。

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: 三十处男
programme.desc: 设计师赵宇庭被批算三十岁前结婚，会被妻子克死，赵父遂严禁赵宇庭结交异性。但限期将届，他急不及待觅对象。荔玲与母亲同为死人化妆师，为了交男友改为新娘化妆，此时她认识了赵宇庭...

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Gifted salesman Siu Buck travels to Turkey to uncover his roots, only to find himself entangled in his spy father's dangerous legacy. Caught in an international conspiracy involving a lethal bioterror threat, he is thrust into a high-stakes chase. As danger closes in, Buck must push beyond his limits to stop a global crisis.

programme.title: 特务迷城
programme.desc: 天赋异禀的健身器材店员小北跨国寻亲，意外卷入特务父亲遗留的谜局，远赴土耳其追寻身世与巨额遗产，却不料陷入国际反恐阴谋。面对炭疽病毒引发的全球危机，小北在土耳其街头展开惊心动魄的跨国大逃亡。在重重谜局的考验中，他突破自我极限，从平凡蜕变为守护世界的孤胆英雄。

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie becomes a night guard at an abandoned building. Hours after their shift change, the previous guard is found murdered in a locked room, making Wang the prime suspect. As eerie events unfold, three vengeful ghosts appear and reveal a revenge plot. With misfortune piling up, is it fate or a curse?

programme.title: 夜守
programme.desc: 一场可怕车祸后失忆的王人杰，找到一份废弃大厦的夜间警卫工作。当晚交接的老守卫举止怪异，数小时后竟陈尸密室，王人杰瞬间成为头号嫌疑犯。诡异事件接连发生，旧日恩怨与冤魂浮现，三只厉鬼如约而至，揭开一场蓄谋已久的复仇计划。接踵而来的厄运，究竟是命运还是诅咒？

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called “Kung Fu Stuntmen”. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: 龙虎武师
programme.desc: 香港动作电影向来以龙虎武师的真功夫蜚声国际。这部纪录片向过去所有的龙虎武师致敬，并用上超过两年时间梳理了海量的影像资料，更采访了无数动作特技演员分享拍摄时的辛酸事迹，当中包括著名武打巨星成龙、甄子丹及洪金宝。

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: 开棺
programme.desc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盗墓团伙重现江城，再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盗墓贼在开棺时遇惊魂邪煞，逃离后又接连惨死家中。最终古墓尸毒和针孔成为留给员警沈春合仅有的线索，看似普通的盗墓案，瞬间扑朔迷离疑点重重。

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: 烈探
programme.desc: 警探张荼为救落入人贩之手的儿子，不惜孤身深入敌穴，跨国追击，但却被牵扯进大型儿童拐卖案。在寻找儿子的过程中，他和身份神秘的女子携手捣毁了一个大型国际犯罪集团，上演了一场惊心动魄的绝地生死营救。

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: 逃学威龙三之龙过鸡年
programme.desc: 富商王百万被发现离奇死于酒店房间，由于周星星与他极为相似，星星再次接受任务，作卧底调查这宗谋杀案。王百万生前与妻子感情早已破裂，妻子因此成为头号嫌疑人。然而，在调查过程中，星星发现王百万的友人林大岳同样形迹可疑……

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After betrayal by his trusted deputy and the death of his daughter, ruthless warlord Hau Kit loses everything and seeks refuge at Shaolin Temple. There, he begins a journey toward redemption. However, when his former deputy Cho Man leads troops to destroy the city, Hau Kit must rise again to protect Shaolin and atone for his past sins.

programme.title: 新少林寺
programme.desc: 骄横军阀侯杰在惨遭亲信曹蛮残酷背叛、痛失至爱幼女后，心灰意冷下大彻大悟投身少林隐姓埋名。不料野心勃勃的叛将曹蛮紧随其后引兵屠城，使千年古刹少林危在旦夕。已皈依佛门的侯杰重拾昔日信念，在这场充满血色的因果轮回中，誓以血肉之躯筑起最后的救赎。

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: 马永贞
programme.desc: 从山东逃难至上海的马永贞，因救了势力人士谭四而受到赏识，又从黑帮头子杨双手上夺取了他在上海的第一个地盘，从此平步青云。杨双与巡捕房勾结，谋害谭四并派人伏杀马永贞…

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.title: 玻璃樽
programme.desc: 台湾女孩阿不前往香港，寻找漂流玻璃樽中那封浪漫纸条的作者阿拔。谁料现实阿拔与幻想的相差甚远，让她心碎失望、决定黯然返乡。就在命运的转角，她遇上富豪企业家陈子午，就此展开一段意想不到的爱情故事。

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: Scientist Yan Xin develops super rubber seeds and travels to a remote, lawless, drug-ridden region to cultivate them. Security captain Lin Xiang leads a team to protect his ex-wife and her crew, but they are besieged by a cartel on arrival. Lin Xiang and his men navigate hostile forces, vowing to take their enemies down with them.

programme.title: 裂战
programme.desc: 科学家颜欣培育出超级橡胶种子，赴毒贩横行的极端之地试种。国际安保队长林翔奉命率队保护前妻及其科研团队，众人刚抵达便遭跨国毒枭围剿。林翔带领生死弟兄，在吞噬人命的法外之地与多方势力周旋，誓与敌人玉石俱焚。

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: 大魔术师
programme.desc: 军阀雷大牛手握重兵，权倾一方，却始终无法赢得三姨太柳遥的芳心。此时，神秘魔术师张贤凭惊世古彩戏法名动京城，并受邀入雷府表演。表面卖艺的他，实则是柳遥昔日未婚夫。在这场真假难辨的奇幻博弈中，张贤暗藏着偷天换日的救人与复仇计画。

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: 冰封侠重生之门
programme.desc: 明朝锦衣卫贺英被诬陷为弑君逆贼，三位结义兄弟奉命追杀。在生死对决之际，四人意外被冰封于时空裂隙。四百年后，他们在现代香港苏醒。一场跨越时代的宿命之战，于陌生都市再度引爆。

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: 撞邪先生
programme.desc: 美容院职员曾小雨机缘巧合之下，认识了富豪之子利志，以为交上好运。岂料利志的父亲是茅山高人，在南洋大败一降头师时，被下咒绝子绝孙，让利志每次恋爱皆遭恶鬼破坏，无疾而终。小雨深爱利志，找大法师沈慈航帮助，授以五色驱邪带，两人顺利结婚。新婚之夜，利志遗失了驱邪彩带，果然恶鬼来犯...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 摄影师陈志成长年被一名「红衣女子」纠缠，导致多位亲人惨死；甚至连自己心仪的女孩思桐亦难逃恶运。志成欲寻找思桐惨死的真相，却揭发关于一场「冥婚」的秘密...

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 摄影师陈志成长年被一名「红衣女子」纠缠，导致多位亲人惨死；甚至连自己心仪的女孩思桐亦难逃恶运。志成欲寻找思桐惨死的真相，却揭发关于一场「冥婚」的秘密...

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: 非法移民
programme.desc: 改编自真实个案，交织着年青偷渡客的友谊、爱情与理想的梦。青年张君秋偷渡纽约，一方面要筹钱还给偷渡集团，另一方面希望通过假结婚获得居留权，故不断找寻假结婚物件。

programme.title: Infernal Affairs II
programme.desc: In this prequel, the secrets of “Infernal Affairs” are revealed - the resentment between police superintendent Wong and crime boss Sam, as well as the beginning of the parallel fates of the two moles, Yan and Ming. The keys lie in the hands of Sam's wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

programme.title: 无间道 II
programme.desc: 《无间道》的秘密最终在此前传中揭露 — 重案组督察黄志诚与黑帮头领韩琛的恩怨和两名卧底陈永仁与刘建明的宿命纠缠何时开始。关键原来系于三个人身上：琛妻、新任黑帮龙头及重案组高层。无间之门亦在这最坏的时代敞开…

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: 看不见的他们
programme.desc: 一场车祸后，林月家里怪事连连。全身冰冷的姐姐在镜子里看不见家人的身影，黑夜里爸爸窥探的双眼，和每天凌晨阁楼传来的弹珠声。林月循声而上去寻找真相，却在打开阁楼的门后，发现里面紧锁的是自己的遗像…

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: 反收数特遣队
programme.desc: 在金融危机期间，绝大多数香港市民陷入债务困境。此时，贵利集团采取无情手段逼迫债务人还款，李探员与其地下部队誓言缉拿这个非法组织的头目。

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: 千王斗千霸
programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: 曼谷风云
programme.desc: 地下拳手林枫因拒绝替曼谷黑帮打黑拳，因此被追杀。他虽成功逃脱，却失去记忆。当林枫开展其新生活时，却被黑帮发现行踪，并找来绝顶打手对付他。期间林枫忽然回复记忆，并誓要将黑帮歼灭。

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: 少年陈真之乱世英雄
programme.desc: 电影讲述清末上海的小人物陈真，在经历苦难及面对无数挑战后，蜕变成长为民族英雄的故事。

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: 花心大少
programme.desc: 严钱声是一名自恃追女高手的富家花花公子，被母亲劝喻要成家立室。他在寻找生命中的女主角时，被两个追女高手挑战。到底他最后能否找到心中最爱?

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao’s enemy. As Guan tries to rescue Liu Bei’s concubine from Cao, he is forced to fight his way through. Can he succeed in the end?

programme.title: 关云长
programme.desc: 这是一场发生在三国动荡时期的史诗式之旅。曹操试图招揽关羽加入他的阵营，但关羽忠于他的结拜兄弟刘备，也是曹操的敌人。当关羽试图从曹操手上救出刘备的小妾时，迫于无奈要大开杀戒。最后他能否杀出重围？

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A reactivated backup Chinese agent, posing as a butcher, is unexpectedly assigned to recover a stolen dinosaur skull. Sent to Hong Kong, he is aided by a female agent who is secretly working for the villains. Together, they navigate betrayals and confront the mastermind, ultimately recovering the national treasure and exposing the conspiracy.

programme.title: 国产凌凌漆
programme.desc: 一名被重新启用的后备中国特工伪装成猪肉贩，意外被派去追回被盗的恐龙头骨。他被派往香港，并在一名暗中为反派效力的女特工协助下展开行动。两人在重重背叛与危机中应对挑战，最终对抗幕后黑手，成功夺回国宝并揭露阴谋。

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: Ten years ago, the ambitious Lord Conqueror sought a prophecy from the Mystic Soothsayer. Told that only two boys named “Wind” and “Cloud” could help him dominate the martial world, he took them as disciples. Though his ambition is fulfilled, the prophecy takes an unexpected turn, unleashing a catastrophe that changes the jianghu forever.

programme.title: 风云雄霸天下
programme.desc: 十年前，笃信命理的「天下会」霸主雄霸请来泥菩萨推算命运。泥菩萨预言，若想称霸武林，必须收两位名字分别带有「风」与「云」的少年为徒，他们将助他成就霸业，也将左右他一生的命运。霸业虽成，预言却骤然逆转，一场由批言引发的武林浩劫，彻底改变了整个武林的命运。

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: 无敌幸运星
programme.desc: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹。大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱。幸运星打算骗”假飞飞”结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计。

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: 倾城之恋
programme.desc: 本片由香港导演许鞍华执导，改编自著名小说家张爱玲的同名小说，是一个发生在日军入侵香港期间的爱情故事。一个内向的上海离婚女子和一个愤世嫉俗的马来西亚花花公子互相倾慕。但因时局动荡，两人多次被迫分开，最终能否有情人终成眷属?

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: 除暴安良
programme.desc: 三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭藉精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。

programme.title: 除暴安良
programme.desc: 三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭藉精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: 画皮
programme.desc: 书生王怀卿卖画，为要筹药费救患重病的妻子，途中意外遇上雀妖的追击，幸得狐妖小容相救。为躲避雀妖，王怀卿将小容带回家中，三人随即陷入一场情感困局，而一段凄美的人妖虐恋亦随即展开。

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: 贼王之王
programme.desc: 两名私家侦探欲藉破一连环大劫案而声名大噪。岂料调查过程中竟一再被贼王使计愚弄，笑话连篇。及后更发现原来所有劫案均与日商宫本有关，到底谁才是真正的贼王之王？

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: 女特警之暗战
programme.desc: 东州地区长期盘踞一支贩毒集团。霹雳女子突击队队员梅静率领其他队员成功攻入贩毒集团的制毒基地，却中了预先设下的埋伏，梅爸爸是犯罪集团内部的卧底身份亦随之暴露。最后，梅静与突击队员们经历一轮激战后，击败对手，并救出梅爸爸。

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: 凌晨两点半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险，传说山中埋着千年女尸，千年不灭之阴火，进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半，依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间，依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间，更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: After his father's death, the impoverished Kwan moves to the provincial capital and works at a textile workshop run by his late father's friend, retired martial artist Tuen. As a ruthless Manchu warlord exploits martial arts tournaments to expand his criminal influence, Kwan and his allies become entangled in a dangerous fight for justice.

programme.title: 赤脚小子
programme.desc: 穷乡青年关丰曜，终日赤着双脚，以背人过河为活。关父临终前，嘱其出城投靠段青云；段骤见故人之子，留下关在布店当小工。关与私塾女教师华小莲交心，却遭莲父白眼；关为求出人头地，竟往投靠土霸喀和布，结果连累莲父与段相继被喀暗算身亡。关得知真相，惜为时已晚，追悔莫及，决与喀拼过死活...

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: 珠光宝气
programme.desc: 一名商人的私生女，无意中擦出神仙阿宝，并得到三个愿望。可惜阿宝法术不精，而发生了很多啼笑皆非的事。

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: 冰封侠之时空行者
programme.desc: 《冰封侠：时空行者》承接前作，四位明朝锦衣卫在现代香港苏醒。为修正历史，贺英独自踏上了寻找「时空金球」的凶险旅程，却不知自己正一步步堕入精心布下的致命陷阱。

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: 我爱神仙遮
programme.desc: 推土车司机阿成，在工作时忽遇地陷而堕入一地下古庙，无意中成为油纸伞妖的主人。她更将自己现身的秘密及超凡的法力告知阿成。地盘工目凡叔嗜赌，欠下恶少高利贷，恶少垂涎凡叔之女美色，要凡叔以女还债；阿成得悉后请伞妖戏弄恶少，并暗助凡叔在赌场获胜，清还债项。惟此神伞之秘密却被恶少发现…

programme.title: Fist of Legend
programme.desc: Sent to Japan by his master, Chen Zhen rescues and falls in love with fellow student Hiroko Yamada, only to be drawn into the Black Dragon gang's conspiracy. As Chinese students disappear and Jing Wu Martial Arts School comes under attack, he joins Liang Shao Wen to destroy a secret lab, foil the conspiracy, and defend his nation's honour.

programme.title: 霍家拳之精武英雄
programme.desc: 陈真奉师命赴日求学，因解救并爱上校友山田广子，就此陷入日本黑龙会的权力纷争。面对华人学生接连失踪、黑龙会渗透打压精武门，他联手热血青年梁少文深入敌营，捣毁秘密实验室并瓦解阴谋，与强敌展开生死决战，誓死守护民族尊严。

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: 十万火急
programme.desc: 这是关于香港消防员的英勇救火故事。勇敢的消防员无惧冲天大火，肩负救灾扶危的重任，甚至舍身救人。但当消防员脱下制服后，是否仍同样勇敢地面对自身的难题呢？

programme.title: The Bullet Vanishes
programme.desc: A series of murders at a munitions factory sparks fear of a “Phantom Bullet” that kills without a trace. Detective Song Dong Lu and sharpshooter Guo Zhui are tasked with solving the case. As they uncover layers of corruption and conspiracy, they are drawn into a deadly game where the truth is more dangerous than the bullets.

programme.title: 消失的子弹
programme.desc: 民国初年，一家兵工厂发生离奇连环命案。死者皆死于枪击，现场却遍寻不到弹头，引发幽灵子弹索命恐慌。警政官松东路与热血神枪手郭追受命联手侦破此案。随着调查深入，两人发现阿森纳内黑幕重重，而真相竟隐藏在一个关于正义与人性堕落的惊人诡计之中。

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: 破坏之王
programme.desc: 外卖员何金银为让他的女神阿丽对他刮目相看，发奋习武，并学了奇怪的招式。胆小怕事的他一次头戴加菲猫面具拯救了阿丽，不料事后被空手道大师段水流领功。银为揭穿真相，最终在擂台使出绝招“无敌风火轮”击败段大师，并抱得美人归。

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: Ex-special forces operative Lung infiltrates a lawless cross-border crime compound after his reporter daughter, On Sum, goes missing while investigating it. When he discovers she is caught in a larger conspiracy, an enraged Lung fights his way through the criminal forces, determined to expose the mastermind behind it all.

programme.title: 怒袭
programme.desc: 前特种兵阿龙为调查记者女儿安心在跨境犯罪园区失踪一事，孤身深入这座由金钱与血腥统治的人间炼狱，揭开电信诈骗、地下血库等黑暗内幕。当发现女儿已卷入更大阴谋，暴怒的阿龙化身冷酷杀神，以铁血手段血战罪恶势力，誓要揪出幕后黑手。

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.title: 猩猩王
programme.desc: 探险家陈正风（李修贤）受聘赴印度森林搜捕猩猩王，结果误堕娱乐公司老板鲁天（谷峰）的圈套，将猩猩王带往香港表演。同行的「女泰山」阿维（伊芙莲嘉）见猩猩王惨遭捉弄摆布，伤心之余更被鲁天意图强奸。猩猩王睹状狂性大发，追击鲁天至市区，市民一片慌乱，军警如临大敌...全片的特技道具，一丝不苟，猩猩王爬上香港当时最高建筑物康乐大厦的镜头，令观众惊异万分。导演远赴泰国森林取景，还有野性美丽的女泰山伊芙莲嘉演出，令人大饱眼福。

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: 怪谈
programme.desc: 在迷雾村，为人养子的文杰反复梦见同一个噩梦。为了解开身世之谜，他卷入连串神秘的失踪案件中。随着更多村民相继离奇死去，村民更深信不疑千年来的井龙王诅咒。于是，文杰与保安队长联手探寻真相，揭开反派阴谋，最终拯救被危害的无辜村民.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

They grow close, even though their mothers have arranged for each of them to mar

programme.title: Night Drama Serial "The Blue Flowers and the Ceramic Forest" Ep. 12 (R)
programme.desc: In Hasami, Nagasaki Prefecture, ceramics are made through a division of labor among local craftspeople. Aoko (Matsui Rena), who grew up there and works as a porcelain painter, enjoys a quiet life until Tatsuki (Ichinose Hayate), a solitary potter, arrives from Finland. When he declares that his pottery needs no painted decoration, Aoko feels he is rejecting not only her work but her entire community. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.
